{
  "question_intent": "Clarification on hedge notional, pre-hedging, and ECLs",
  "main_topics": [
    "Hedge notional",
    "Pre-hedging",
    "ECLs"
  ],
  "answer_completeness": "Complete",
  "response_stance": "Direct",
  "evidence_level": "High",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": true,
  "contains_forward_guidance": false,
  "narrative_alignment": "Aligned",
  "question_quote": "So, I'm not sure if that explains the entire move, but any colour there would be helpful.",
  "answer_quote": "So, actually what happened is prior to this quarter, the General Motors impairment was not modelled. We were essentially using our expectation and our existing portfolios to anticipate what that was going to be, and we put it in as a post-model adjustment. Now what's happened is, we've updated the model, and so General Motors [impairment] is a modelled number. So, you're not going to see any change in the total number. It just jumps from being in the PMA to being in the modelled number.",
  "reason": "The answer directly addresses the question's intent, provides a high level of evidence with specific figures, and aligns with the narrative of the question."
}
